svg.title: How it works: task done, wrap-up writes the handoff and ends with Ready to compact., the mod waits 1.5 s and queues /compact, the summary is saved, and the handoff goes back into the fresh context
svg.text: and checks it is on disk.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Sees the line at turn end.
Runs as if you typed it.
